briefs.task: The owner set the water bar on 14 Nov 2026 as shipped high-end games: "Scenery reflections we must have, that's a main stay in high quality modern games. That's the standard we're after. Camera being able to go under water we need to support as well." The WATERS re-plan of that day left out caustics, underwater light shafts and exposure that adapts under water, which are standard in high-end underwater views; bring the underwater view up to that bar in WATERS (or the owning module), and plan the new module SCENE-VIEWS that WATERS M14 depends on. Choose methods from first principles and current practice. Do not change WATERS M1, which is being built.
